headline: Sewer extensions approved for 72A and 72B Arlington Street, and for 1 Frederick Street and 114 Lincoln Street.
summary: One Arlington Street request is for about 85 feet of sewer, with the work paid for by the applicant. Two Henchman Street extensions run about 146 feet and 40 feet, and the longer one serves 1 Frederick Street and 114 Lincoln Street. DPW recommended the Arlington Street request, and both Henchman Street lines were approved with DPW's conditions.
decisions: Approved 3-0 a sewer extension of about 85 feet for 72A and 72B Arlington Street.
Approved 3-0 two Henchman Street sewer extensions for 1 Frederick Street and 114 Lincoln Street, as amended.
discussion: Henchman Street petitions: Discussion focused on whether one petition could cover both sections of pipe. DPW said they were separate lengths, so the two were approved together.
Arlington Street petition: One online participant spoke on the request and had nothing further to add.
